title: Tag Input
description: An input that turns words into chips — Enter commits, Backspace repents.
a11y: Enter or comma adds a trimmed tag; duplicates are ignored case-insensitively. An empty input Backspace removes the last tag. Horizontal arrows follow visual direction between removal buttons; Delete/Backspace removes the focused tag. Buttons have tag-specific names; status announces additions and removals. Composition keys do not commit tags.
